semantics.uniqueness_rule: Active external identities/bindings are unique within their declared scope.

semantics.ac_rule: When AC is active, direct `$EXT` dereference is disallowed for governed access; remote access proceeds through DWH `>` semantics.

invariants.rule: DWH scope, release, remote access and policy decisions remain explicit, provenance-preserving and separate from transport reachability.

hard_gates.condition: network endpoint used as semantic external identity
